scientific_limitations: Deterministic complete-mixing mean-field equations only, at exact tricritical parameters; finite stochastic populations and spatial lattices are outside scope.
Requires initially positive infection; asymptotic remainder is initial-condition dependent and not uniform near a disease-free initial state.
Neither the tricritical parameter location nor the known critical exponent is claimed as new; remaining priority uncertainty concerns possible equivalent unindexed analyses.
title: Universal two-term clearance and a single infection peak at the vaccination tricritical point
